essential: Play Hurrican, a run-and-gun platformer. Progress right through the jungle, shoot enemies and survive. Coordinates are world pixels; positive x is right and positive y is DOWN. Enemy positions are nearby on-screen destroyable objects. Each input is held for 40 fixed60Hz native updates. The game pauses while you decide. Shooting and jumping follow the original game's rules.

action.instructions: Choose the next input to progress and survive.

criteria.shoot: Shoot in the current facing direction.
criteria.crouch_shoot: Crouch and shoot in the current facing direction.
